How we score

  • One brand, one finish, one store. GE Profile, Frigidaire Gallery and LG STUDIO count as their own brands.
  • Appliance score, 0 to 100: owner ratings pooled across major retailers, repair-tech reliability rankings and other research we track.
  • Package score: the average of its four appliances.
  • Every model: 250+ owner reviews. Fridges: 17.5 cu ft+. Installed dishwashers and microwaves only.
  • Lowe’s and Best Buy prices, current sales included. Bundle savings follow Lowe’s tiers.
